Situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]], the '''Yuvern system''' contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yuvern/Legends|Yuvern]], [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the two-headed, [[Snake/Legends|snakelike]] [[Yuvernian/Legends|Yuvernian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Yuvern [[Star system/Legends|system]] was at some point visited by the [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]], who took the Yuvernian [[Cane Adiss/Legends|Cane Adiss]] from his homeworld and trained him to become a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Upon becoming a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]], Adiss was sent back to Yuvern to deliver a cargo of illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]].

Arriving in-system, however, Adiss encountered the entire [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was forced to let Imperial [[Inspector/Legends|inspectors]] aboard [[Adiss's ship|his starship]]. At that point, the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was unexpectedly [[Battle in the Yuvern system|attacked]] by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] force and retreated to [[Harrod's Planet]]. Adiss was ordered to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] the Imperials aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to regroup with the rest of the fleet, after which the smuggler returned to Yuvern and finished his assignment for Jabba.

==Description==
The Yuvern [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Yuvern/Legends|same name]].<ref name="DB" />

==History==
[[File:CaneAdiss-SWChronicles.png|thumb|right|200px|The Yuvernian Cane Adiss hailed from the Yuvern system and was present during a battle there.]]
At some point, the [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Kal'Falnl C'ndros]] visited the planet Yuvern. C'ndros took the [[Yuvernian/Legends|Yuvernian]] [[Cane Adiss/Legends|Cane Adiss]], who longed to leave his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], offworld and taught him to become a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Adiss eventually became a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] in the employ of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]<ref name="DB" /> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]],<ref name="CSWE Jabba">{{CSWECite|II|130|Jabba the Hutt (Jabba Desilijic Tiure)}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]].<ref name="DB" />

The Yuvernian's first assignment,<ref name="DB" /> given by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="2 ABY">{{DB|character|caneadiss|Adiss, Cane}} places [[Cane Adiss/Legends|Cane Adiss's]] first mission in the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] as the [[battle in the Yuvern system]]. In addition, [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]] states that [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vernan (general)|Vernan]] was still alive eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after that engagement. Finally, ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' establishes that Vernan had [[Death/Legends|died]] by the time of the sourcebook's setting. Since ''Alliance Intelligence Reports'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]"&mdash;corresponding to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''&mdash;Adiss must have traveled to the Yuvern [[Star system/Legends|system]] on behalf of Jabba at some point by 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> took him back to his homeworld. Upon arriving in the Yuvern system, Adiss discovered that the entire [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was also present. The smuggler was forced to let Imperial [[Inspector/Legends|inspectors]] aboard [[Adiss's ship|his starship]]; however, before Adiss's illegal cargo could be discovered, the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was unexpectedly [[Battle in the Yuvern system|attacked]] by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Line of battle|battle line]]. The [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] aboard Adiss's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] then ordered the Yuvernian to regroup with the rest of the retreating fleet at [[Harrod's Planet]]. After [[Transport/Legends|transporting]] the Imperials per his orders, Adiss returned to Yuvern and finished his assignment for Jabba.<ref name="DB" />

Eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, the Oplovis Sector Fleet raised its supply requisitions from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] by 4.1 percent. When Rebel [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zgorth'sth]] learned of that fact, he acted upon a hunch and reviewed operational records he had briefly read nine [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] prior. While he was scanning the records, Zgorth'sth recalled the engagement between the Oplovis Sector Fleet and the Alliance battle line but did not remember the location of the battle and had to look it up. Zgorth'sth's analysis of the Oplovis fleet's activities since the engagement in the Yuvern system eventually led the commander to arrange for Alliance assets to monitor the fleet.<ref name="TRAS2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Yuvernian/Legends}}
The Yuvern system<ref name="EAOC" /> planet of the same name was the homeworld of the sentient Yuvernians, a species of long,<ref name="DB" /> two-headed, [[Snake/Legends|snakelike]] [[Alien/Legends|aliens]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|11|Adiss, Cane}}</ref> The Yuvernians were already known to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> by [[6900 BBY]].<ref name="6900 BBY">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' establishes that the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Sorzus Syn]] knew of the [[Yuvernian/Legends|Yuvernians]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exiles]] arrived in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]] in the aftermath of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] dates the end of that conflict to [[6900 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Yuvern system was first mentioned in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', a [[1990]] [[West End Games]] supplement authored by [[Paul Murphy]] and published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RAS1">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square M-5.<ref name="TEA" />
